title: lamium album subsp. crinitum
intro: Lamium album subsp. crinitum, commonly known as White Spurred Lamium or White Spurred Dead Nettle, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and relieving respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have been identified in various studies.
